merged.title: feat(overlays): thirteen functions that return through shared fragments
merged.author: cnobis
merged.untrustedBody:
Thirteen exact matches, one commit each, and the progress report in its own last commit. Each function branches to code after its own end (the shared return fragments `func_001E97C8`, `func_00208238`, `func_001E9768`, `func_L00_002347F0`), so each gains a row in `config/overlays/joined.tsv`. `func_L00_002CC390` returns through two consecutive copies of `func_001E97C8`, so its row lists that piece twice. `try_func`, `overlay_file_check` and `gen_progress_report.py --check` all take it.

## Slot 4 of the enemy class tables

Four of them are the same accessor, slot 4 of a moby class's 6-word table: the moby's pvars plus an offset, or 0 without a moby or pvars. Each was the last function of some class tables still in assembly, so this completes eleven of them:

| Function | Offset | Classes |
|---|---|---|
| `func_L00_002D6CB0` | 0xD0 | horny_toad (749), gadgebot (1906, the ones Drek releases in the final fight) |
| `func_L01_002F31D0` | 0x60 | peckbot, scoutbot, robosquawker, mine, chompe
